title: Taj Mahal
description: A masterpiece of Mughal architecture, the Taj Mahal transforms with the light—from luminous white by day to a serene golden glow after dark.

title: Amber Fort
description: Rising above Maota Lake, Amber Fort blends Rajput strength with Mughal artistry across grand courtyards, gateways, and mirrored halls.

title: Mysore Palace
description: This Indo-Saracenic royal residence pairs ornate domes and arches with a dazzling evening illumination that transforms its entire façade.

title: Virupaksha Temple
description: At the heart of Hampi, this living Shiva temple is crowned by a soaring gopuram whose carved tiers dominate the historic landscape.

title: Ajanta and Ellora Caves
description: These monumental rock-cut cave complexes preserve centuries of Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain sculpture, painting, and architectural ingenuity.

title: Brihadisvara Temple
description: Built by the Cholas, this granite masterpiece is celebrated for its monumental vimana, precise geometry, and exquisite stone carvings.

title: Konark Sun Temple
description: Designed as Surya's colossal stone chariot, the temple is famed for its sculpted wheels, horses, and intricate 13th-century craftsmanship.

title: Sanchi Stupa
description: One of India's oldest Buddhist monuments, the Great Stupa is encircled by richly carved gateways that narrate stories of faith and history.

title: Khajuraho Temples
description: The Chandela-era temples of Khajuraho are celebrated for soaring shikharas and remarkably detailed sandstone carvings.

title: Meenakshi Amman Temple
description: A living temple complex in Madurai, known for its towering, vividly sculpted gopurams and richly layered Dravidian artistry.

title: Ramappa Temple
description: The Kakatiya-era Ramappa Temple is admired for its intricate stonework, sculpted pillars, and distinctive floating-brick construction.

title: Hawa Mahal
description: Jaipur's Palace of Winds is an ornate rose-pink facade of jharokhas, latticework, and graceful Rajput-era symmetry.

title: Qutub Minar
description: The Qutub Minar rises above the historic complex in bands of red sandstone and marble, richly carved with inscriptions and ornament.

title: Humayun's Tomb
description: Set along a symmetrical Charbagh garden, Humayun's Tomb is a landmark of Mughal architecture in red sandstone and white marble.

title: Hampi Stone Chariot
description: The iconic Stone Chariot at Vittala Temple is a masterwork of Vijayanagara stone carving, framed by Hampi's granite landscape.

title: Himalayan Valleys
description: Remote Himalayan valleys bloom with wild alpine flowers.

title: Dal Lake Sunrise, Kashmir
description: Shikara boats glide through the still morning waters of Dal Lake as the Zabarwan mountains catch the first light of day.

title: Munnar Tea Gardens
description: Rolling emerald hills blanketed in tea bushes at 1,600 metres elevation.

title: Bengal Tiger
description: Ranthambore National Park is one of India's best places to spot the Bengal tiger in the wild.

title: Elephants in Periyar
description: Wild elephants roaming through the dense green forests of South India.

title: Hyderabadi Biryani
description: Dum-cooked over slow coal fire, Hyderabadi Biryani is a world famous culinary heritage.

title: Delhi Street Food
description: A vibrant assortment of North Indian street food delicacies.

title: South Indian Thali
description: A traditional feast served on a fresh banana leaf.

title: Holi — Festival of Colours
description: Celebrated with intensity, Holi marks the arrival of spring with clouds of vibrant colour powder.

title: Diwali Lamps
description: During Diwali, millions of earthen lamps are lit, creating a vision of timeless devotion.

title: Durga Puja, Kolkata
description: Kolkata's Durga Puja transforms the city into the world's largest open-air art installation.
